## Professional Overview
Tarek Al Ahmadieh is a full-stack software engineer, deep learning researcher, and indie game developer. He specializes in building high-performance web applications, financial and healthcare management platforms, AI-driven medical diagnostic systems, and interactive 2D games.

## Services Available for Clients & Employers
- **Full-Stack Web Application Development**: Custom web applications, SaaS platforms, internal admin dashboards, and RESTful/WebSocket APIs using React, TypeScript, NestJS, Tailwind CSS, PostgreSQL, and Prisma ORM.
- **AI & Deep Learning Solutions**: Computer vision (CNNs, ResNet, U-Net, Swin UNETR), tabular ensembles (LightGBM, CatBoost, XGBoost), explainable AI (SHAP, Grad-CAM), and model evaluation with stratified cross-validation.
- **Indie Game Development**: 2D action/adventure games, physics mechanics, level design, and web/cross-platform deployment using Godot Engine and GDScript.
- **Systems & Low-Level Programming**: Custom HTTP servers, image processing algorithms, and CLI utilities in C and Linux TCP sockets.

## Key Projects
- **BraTS 2021 Brain Tumor Segmentation**: PyTorch/MONAI 3D U-Net baseline, 5 epochs on the 1,251 training cases: 80.5 / 62.9 / 66.2 Dice (WT / TC / ET) on a 25% patient-level hold-out.
- **BraTS 2021 MGMT Radiogenomics**: Gated-Attention MIL on pre-operative MRI, 0.566 ± 0.039 ROC-AUC in 5-fold cross-validation.
- **Kaggle Playground S6E9 — Top 4.7%**: Ranked 167 of 3,575 predicting EV purchases using leak-free target encoding and LightGBM/CatBoost/XGBoost ensemble.
- **Diabetic Neuropathy Classification (TogetherforChehim)**: Plantar-pressure classification using CNNs, ResNet-18 transfer learning, and Grad-CAM interpretability.
- **MednMind Full-Stack Dashboard & Financial Reporting**: Healthcare administration platform with RBAC, revenue analytics, and patient workflows.
- **Indie Games on itch.io**: Runeblade, Golfyio, and Dereled (built with Godot and GDScript).
- **HTTP Server & QR Code Generator**: High-performance socket server and QR generator written in C.
